_comment: Managers' OWN availability pages — the second way to learn a building has an apartment free
(owner, 2026-09-23). Sourced from the register's largest organisations by stabilized units,
then each page fetched and checked. Unlike rerental_pages.json these are mostly MARKET-RATE
listings, which is why they feed vacancies.json and never the affordable re-rental tiles.
